title: Causal-TGAN
summary: A research implementation of Causal-TGAN, a causally-aware GAN for generating synthetic tabular data from a causal graph, presented at the ICLR 2022 Workshop on Deep Generative Models for Highly Structured Data. Its data preprocessing pipeline (dataset.py) imports OneHotEncodingTransformer directly from the standalone rdt package to reversibly encode categorical columns before training.
needs: Unclear whether OneHotEncodingTransformer is actually invoked elsewhere in dataset.py; only the import line is captured in evidence.
